Author: Alok Kumar Verma
Bench: Alok Kumar Verma
 Office Notes,
 reports, orders or
Sl. proceedings or
 Date Court'S Or Judges'S Order
S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  16.10. ABA No.938 of 2023  2023 Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.

Present Application has been filed under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of Anticipatory Bail under Sections 323, 504, 506, Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code,
1860 and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 in connection with the Case Crime No.571 of 2023, registered at police station Patel Nagar, District Dehradun.
2. Applicant - accused no.1 is the husband of the informant/victim.
Applicant no.2 is the brother of the applicant no.1 and applicant no.3 is the mother of the applicant no.1.

3. Heard Mr. Bilal Ahmed, learned counsel for the applicants and Mr. M.K. Chand, learned AGA for the State.
4.
Mr. Bilal Ahmed, Advocate, submits that there is every possibility of settlement between the parties.
5. Issue notice to the informant Smt. Azara.
Steps to be taken within three days.

6. List on 22.11.2023 for hearing on the Anticipatory Bail Application.
7.
(iii) Applicants shall not leave the country without the previous permission of this Court.

(Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 16.10.2023 Pant/

opennyai_summary.decision:
Mr. Bilal Ahmed, Advocate, submits that there is every possibility of settlement between the parties.
Steps to be taken within three days.
6. List on 22.11.2023 for hearing on the Anticipatory Bail Application.
7.
In the facts and circumstances of the case, applicants - Mohd. Aamir, Mohd. Aadil and Naushad Begum are directed to be released on Interim Anticipatory Bail, in the event of their arrest, on furnishing their personal bond of Rs. 30,000/- and two reliable sureties, each in the like amount on the following conditions:-
(i) Applicants shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person, acquainted with the facts of this case;
(ii) Applicants shall cooperate with the Investigating Agency and they shall make themselves available at the time of interrogation by the Investigating Agency as and when required;
